name: fireworks
long_description: Bring your Fireworks inference API key. Inference is charged to your Fireworks account. Saving, replacing and testing keys read one account name and require account-list access; they do not verify inference permissions or credit balance. The gateway keeps the key off your Sprite. Supports chat completions, completions and embeddings, including SSE responses. GET /v1/accounts also lets authorized Sprites read all account metadata visible to the key, with caller-selected query parameters, not just the test's single account name. Account writes, model administration, deployments, files and batches are not supported.

examples.title: Chat completion (charged to your Fireworks account)
notes: Replace the placeholder with a model ID from the Fireworks model catalog.

messages.403: Fireworks key requires account-list permission; inference-only keys cannot be verified

presentation.tagline: OpenAI-compatible inference without storing your Fireworks key on a Sprite.
presentation.setup: Create an inference key at app.fireworks.ai/settings/users/api-keys.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Inference is charged to your Fireworks account. Saving, replacing and testing read one account name and require account-list permission; they do not verify inference permission or balance.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Supports `POST` chat/completions, completions and embeddings under `/inference/v1`, including SSE, plus `GET /v1/accounts`, which lets authorized Sprites list account metadata visible to the key, not only the name read during validation. No account writes, deployments, files or batches.
